mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 300.0 in CPIAUCSL signals overheating that triggers aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signal stagflation where monetary tightening coincides with labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%) signal weak consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 55% of periods when HOUST is above 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 680,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when RSAFS < 680000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad-based economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when HOUST falls > 5% and INDPRO falls > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0) signal reduced corporate production capacity and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
